name: G4 Real-Task Work-Tree DeepSeek V4 Pro Directive Required Live
suiteRoleNote: Single live experiment: require runtime-applied work-tree directives for node switching, add leaf scope checkpoints, and use snapshot-backed diagnostic follow-up to analyze workflow drift.

cases.title: G4 Work-Tree DeepSeek V4 Pro Directive Required: Grid Storage Research
cases.taskGoal: Use network search to compare at least four long-duration energy storage routes for 2030 grid balancing (Li-ion, sodium-ion, flow battery, and green hydrogen), then produce a recommendation for a mid-size grid operator under cost, safety, and deployment-speed constraints.
cases.currentObjective: Deliver a web-grounded comparison report while requiring runtime-applied work-tree directives for every node switch.

currentContext.title: decision scope
currentContext.content: Target operator profile: peak load 3-6 GW, renewable share 45%-60%, procurement horizon to 2030. Decision criteria must include levelized storage cost range, safety risk profile, supply-chain risk, and implementation lead time.

currentContext.title: runtime directive rule
currentContext.content: Switching or completing work-tree nodes is a runtime state change, not prose. Natural-language claims such as 'I create/enter Leaf 2' or 'Leaf Handoff' do not change currentNodeId or mark a child complete. To create a child, output <work-node-create ...></work-node-create>. To enter an existing node, output <work-node-enter nodeId="..."></work-node-enter>. To complete the current child/leaf and hand evidence back to the parent, output <work-node-complete status="completed">...</work-node-complete>.

currentContext.title: child scope checkpoint
currentContext.content: Before concrete tool work starts in a child/leaf node, confirm the node scope, the stopping point, and the return path to the parent. A leaf returns useful findings, evidence refs, discarded routes, gaps, and risks through <work-node-complete status="completed">...</work-node-complete>; it must not declare the whole task complete.

currentContext.title: node-local toolcall budget
currentContext.content: Each work-tree node has only 5 toolcall opportunities. If more concrete search/fetch/read/compute/edit work is needed, create or enter a child leaf before continuing. Entering a new node refreshes the 5 toolcall opportunities for that node.

currentContext.title: delivery contract
currentContext.content: Tool execution is enabled. Build the report from verifiable web evidence. Include a source table and explicitly discuss at least one contradiction between sources and how it was resolved.

cases.responseRequirements: Use network search and deliver a complete comparison report in Markdown. Hard work-tree rule: 换工作节点或完成 child/leaf 必须操作工作树，自然语言说换节点或 Leaf Handoff 无效；if you need a new leaf, emit <work-node-create ...></work-node-create>; if you need an existing node, emit <work-node-enter nodeId="..."></work-node-enter>; if the current child/leaf reached its stopping point, emit <work-node-complete status="completed">...</work-node-complete> with result, evidence, gaps/risks, and parent-next notes. Each LLM window may emit at most one current-node-changing work-tree directive; after emitting it, stop and let the next window continue in the new/runtime-updated node. If runtime tells you work-tree-directive-required, first emit exactly one valid directive and stop. Before concrete tool work in any child/leaf, confirm node scope, stopping point, and return path to parent. Concrete tool-backed work belongs in leaf nodes; parent/orchestrator nodes do workflow control, evaluate child completions, choose the next leaf, and may create a final synthesis/report-writing child. A final synthesis child may draft the complete report, but it must return the draft, source table, residual gaps, and risks through work-node-complete; the parent/orchestrator recognizes the child result and declares whole-task completion. Each node has only 5 toolcall opportunities; if more tool work is needed, create/enter a child leaf; if the leaf is done, complete it with work-node-complete. Include: (1) comparison matrix across Li-ion, sodium-ion, flow battery, green hydrogen; (2) explicit contradiction analysis with resolution rationale; (3) source table with URL/domain/published date/key claim. Output Markdown only.
cases.restartMessage: Window restart: preserve the runtime directive rule. Natural-language claims do not switch currentNodeId or complete a leaf. If currentNodeId is root or a parent/orchestrator and concrete tool work is needed, first emit a valid work-node directive. If currentNodeId is a leaf, confirm scope/stopping point/return path before tool work, use at most 5 toolcalls, then output exactly one <work-node-complete status="completed">...</work-node-complete> directive and stop. Output Markdown only.
cases.toolResultReflectionReminder: Workflow control checkpoint: after each tool batch, count the current node's toolcalls and reassess whether the next action should continue this leaf, create/enter a child node with a real directive, return to parent evaluation, or deliver.

workTreeNodeToolCallSoftLimit.warningMessage: 警告：当前工作树节点已经超过本节点的 5 次 toolcall 机会。你应该进行工作流程上的安排：如果还需要更多具体工具工作，创建或进入子节点；如果当前 leaf 已经完成，用 <work-node-complete status="completed">...</work-node-complete> 把结果、证据、缺口和风险交给父节点评估。下次 toolcall 将被拒绝。

postCompletionActions.userMessage: 这个任务还不能只靠报告结束。先做任务控制分析：对照工作树快照、currentNodeId、未完成 child/sibling、leaf handoff 和父节点职责，判断是否需要回滚到父节点或进入 leaf。然后继续执行，不要只解释原因。
postCompletionActions.resumeMessage: Revision after possible workflow drift: first perform task-control analysis, then continue from the auto-selected unfinished work-tree position. Node switching requires real work-tree directives; natural language does not change currentNodeId.
postCompletionActions.currentObjective: Continue from the correct work-tree position, enforce runtime directives for node switches, and only deliver after all required storage routes and contradiction analysis are complete.
postCompletionActions.responseRequirements: First output a concise Task Control Analysis identifying currentNodeId, runtime work-tree state, whether a claimed leaf switch/handoff had an applied directive, unfinished child/sibling nodes, missing routes/evidence, and the next node/action. If a node switch is needed, emit exactly one valid <work-node-create ...></work-node-create> or <work-node-enter nodeId="..."></work-node-enter> directive; if the current child/leaf is done, emit exactly one <work-node-complete status="completed">...</work-node-complete> directive with result, evidence, gaps/risks, and parent-next notes. Do not emit enter/create and complete in the same LLM window; after one current-node-changing directive, stop. Natural language is not enough. Then continue the unfinished work. Output Markdown only.
postCompletionActions.toolResultReflectionReminder: Workflow control checkpoint: after each tool batch, reassess currentNodeId, unfinished nodes, and whether the next action requires a real work-tree directive.

workTreeNodeToolCallSoftLimit.warningMessage: 警告：当前工作树节点已经超过本节点的 5 次 toolcall 机会。你应该进行工作流程上的安排：如果还需要更多具体工具工作，创建或进入子节点；如果当前 leaf 已经完成，用 <work-node-complete status="completed">...</work-node-complete> 把结果、证据、缺口和风险交给父节点评估。下次 toolcall 将被拒绝。

postCompletionActions.userMessage: 侧信道工作状态诊断：请只分析刚才这轮任务，不要补报告。根据 runtime/work-tree snapshot、对话和工具痕迹回答：1 当前 runtime 认为你在哪个 currentNodeId，与你自述的 leaf/parent 位置是否一致？2 如果主线已经脱离工作树控制，应回滚到哪个节点/哪一步继续？3 你任务飘逸的原因是什么，是没有发 directive、父节点做了 leaf 工作、leaf 宣告整体完成，还是别的？4 下一次 continuation 第一条应该输出什么 directive 或控制动作？
